line_check.method: Matched original nonempty source lines against #line coordinates, including inactive boundaries and comments. Existing mismatches listed explicitly.

verification.scope: Fresh byte comparison, filtered metrics and line stream validation. Historical native callback evidence; no runtime code change.

decision: R2216: NtUserEnableWindow synchronously notifies the owner, which can destroy the dialog and free PDLG before the two result writes. Published negative control removing this guard saw three access violations; retained guard passed 22 cases. Removed only three redundant unconditional #line directives. Verified exact (logical coordinate, source line) equality against HEAD for every non-marker line in both files.
